_note: Hand corrections, keyed by the exact item name on the menu. roles: fix an automatic classification (entree | starch | side | soup | dessert | bread | addon); re-run `dcsim prepare` after editing. popularity: multiplier on the role prior from staff experience (e.g. 1.8 = runs out, 0.5 = left over); applies at load time, and the baseline kitchen plan deliberately does NOT know about it. station_popularity: multiplier on every dish at a station; unlike item-level popularity, the baseline kitchen plan knows it (team member 2026-11-12: Street Food, Noodle Bowl, Grill, Latino are about 2x an ordinary station; since engine 0.6.0 Noodle Bowl's 2x is per dish in dish_popularity, ISSUES E6). dish_popularity: a crowd-drawing dish the kitchen knows about.

station_by_date._note: Per-date station moves (E7): a dish named here is served at that station on that date instead of its published one.
